services.name: Heart pine restoration
services.blurb: Old heart pine sanded gently, gaps filled with reclaimed slivers, and finished to keep the amber.

services.name: Water-damaged floor repair
services.blurb: Cupped or blackened boards after a leak or flood dried, cut out and replaced to match.

services.name: Waterproof plank floors
services.blurb: Rigid-core plank for ground floors and rentals that see wet feet, pets and high tides.

services.name: Crawlspace moisture check
services.blurb: We read moisture under the house before laying wood, and tell you plainly if it needs work first.

services.name: Hardwood refinishing
services.blurb: Oak and maple sanded and refinished, with tired thresholds and old water rings worked out.

services.name: Tile for baths & laundry
services.blurb: Porcelain set on a membrane in the rooms where water lands, from bath to laundry.

services.name: Engineered hardwood
services.blurb: A real wood face on a stable core that copes with humid summers better than solid boards.

services.name: Stairs & landings
services.blurb: Old stair treads refinished or replaced to match the floor at the top and bottom.

services.name: Single board replacement
services.blurb: One or two bad boards replaced with old stock that matches age, width and color.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our 1912 house in Ghent has heart pine that three owners painted over. Andre stripped it by hand around the edges and refinished it amber. He saved the worst boards for the closet.
reviews.name: Margaret S.

reviews.text: After the September nor'easter our front rooms had cupped boards along the wall. They dried them out over a week, replaced eleven, and the patch is invisible.
reviews.name: Ty R.

reviews.text: The rental by the inlet floods the ground floor every few years. Waterproof plank went down in two days. After the last tide we mopped and moved on.
reviews.name: Bethany K.

reviews.text: Before quoting, he crawled under the house and showed me the moisture reading on his phone. Vapor barrier first, then the engineered floor. It still sits flat a year later.
reviews.name: Omar F.

reviews.text: One scorched board in front of the old fireplace. They found a matching board from a house being torn down in Portsmouth and swapped it in. Same width, same color.
reviews.name: Hazel D.

reviews.text: Our Colonial Place stairs creaked on every step and the finish was gone. Now they are quiet, refinished, and match the hall floor upstairs.
reviews.name: Jordan V.

proof.guarantee: If boards we installed cup or gap in 2 years, we come back, find out why and fix it.
